cs.t: Tangentially related - I recently got the holy grail of eSIM travel router setup: - GLiNet Mudi v2:  https://store.gl-inet.com/products/mudi-v2-portable-4g-lte-r...  - EIOT Physical eSim  https://store.gl-inet.com/products/esim-experience-seamless-...  - 20GB Worldwide Airalo for 365 days ($69):  https://www.airalo.com/global-esim/discover-365days-20gb  Buy the airalo esim on my iphone. Download the QR code. Upload it to the mudi router. Activate it there. Voila! I then wireguard back to my home internet in case I need a US on the router. Can also use tailscale, but if my gf wants US internet its helpful.  https://docs.gl-inet.com/router/en/4/tutorials/how_to_set_up...
